notes: Sector pass 2026-10-20 (see data/reference/s08_damascus.md, section 'Sector pass'). The open areas keep the street space between the mapped OSM walls free of infill: the infill corridor (25th percentile of the distance to the nearest building, 1.4-3.5 m) put 1.5-4 m deep infill strips in front of the real street walls of the Damascus Gate street, Khan ez-Zeit and Al-Wad (Al-Wad came out 3.4 m wide where OSM gives 4.7-7.6 m, Khan ez-Zeit 3.0 m where OSM gives 4.1-4.3 m, the foot of the Damascus Gate street 4 m where OSM and D28/D30 give 8-9 m).

open_areas.why: Damascus Gate street (w616186086), inner square (pedestrian area w1549494830 + 3 m to the mapped walls), the foot of the street and the Khan ez-Zeit mouth, clipped 0.15 m off the OSM footprints. OSM wall-to-wall 16-21 m in the square and 8.9-9 m at the foot between w1393172385 and w1392390323 (notes 1.5); D28 and D30 show the Taha greengrocer/Halawani fronts of w1393172385 opening straight onto the street with the steps in front, D29/D01 show shop rows on both sides of the square. Baseline infill f45/f47/f48 stood in front of these walls.

Khan ez-Zeit north (w256298879, y 430-484): OSM wall-to-wall 4.1-4.3 m between w1393419050/w1393280743/w1393172387 (E) and r3864717/w1393419044/w1393172386 (W) (notes 1.6, measured); D41 shows a ~4 m souq with shop doors on both sides and OSM shop nodes sit in both rows (shoes, clothes, confectionery, jewellery, butcher, toys). Baseline infill f45/f294/f360 narrowed it to 3.0 m and hid the west row.

Al-Wad north (w26496070, fork to y 430): OSM 4.7-6.2 m between w1393419059/58/56, w1394466520, w1393419055 (NE) and w1393172388, w1393419049, w290996201, w1393280741 (SW) (notes 1.7 review, measured), with OSM shop nodes on both sides (Alasel pastry, pharmacy, confectionery, convenience, sweets). Baseline infill f48/f361/f58 made it 3.4 m wide along its whole length.

Ash Sheikh Rihan (w26492740) is an open lane from the fork to the east (it is the only link from the fork to Rassas Ascent and the residential quarter), but OSM tags it layer=-2, so the infill ignores it and blocked it over ~150 m (f48, f57, f59, f60, f66). 3.2 m strip along the centreline (notes 1.8: lanes 2.1-3.8 m, p25 3.8 m).

requests: BASE REBUILD NEEDED: the s08 open areas and the four removed roofs change where buildings stand, but the base ground (game/public/base/ground.glb, built from data/spec/base.json) was triangulated around the old infill and roof footprints. Until base is rebuilt from a spec that includes this profile, those spots have no ground (sky shows through in the d28, d29, d30 renders at the foot of the Damascus Gate street and the KeZ mouth; also Al-Wad north, Ash Sheikh Rihan and the four roof sites) and a player would fall through. Please rebuild base after merging.

CANOPY SHEETS INVISIBLE FROM BELOW (facade_build/_canopy + the mesh merge in build_city): the canopy and awning quads are added twice (top and bottom, same vertices) but only one face per canopy survives in the built sector (build/s08_damascus.blend: 23 'awning' polygons for 22 canopies/awnings in the s08 spec, e.g. 2 on w291225673 for its two canopies), and the 'awning' material has backface culling on (blend HASHED). From street level only the green brackets and tubes show (renders d01, d28, d29), so the shed canopies that define every souq street read as empty frames. Keep both faces (offset the underside ~1 cm) or turn culling off for 'awning'.

STREET SECTION (stairs.py / spec owner): the Damascus Gate street w616186086 is split lengthwise for its whole length from the inner exit (275.4,551.8) to the fork (308.3,496.2): the west 2.5-3.5 m is a continuous ramp of small grey setts (~9 %), the rest full-width limestone steps (risers 0.15-0.17 m, treads 1.0-1.5 m, occasional 3-4 m landings), with a broad 3-5 step flight across the whole width just below the inner portal. Evidence D01, D27, D28, D30 (notes 1.5); fall 751.2 -> 743.9 m (street model). Today the generic step runs cover the full width.

FABRIC COVERINGS (facades.py / facade_build.py / dressing.py): the Damascus Gate street and inner square need (a) retractable striped fabric awnings with scalloped white valances (green-white, grey-white, red-white; D01, D24, D28, D29), (b) white tarps strung across the street at ~4 m between the canopy fronts (D01, D24, D27), (c) large market umbrellas (printed blue, green, rainbow; D01, D27, D29), (d) tan canvas sheds ~2 m deep (D30). All awnings/canopies are corrugated sheet today; I set canopies (depth 1.4-1.9 m) on every shop front of the street as the closest available feature.

DOOR ATLAS (gen_textures.py doors_atlas, 4x4 full): cells for the closed Khan ez-Zeit / Damascus Gate shops: grey and beige multi-leaf panelled steel doors (4-6 leaves ~0.5 m wide, 2-3 raised panels each, surface hasps and padlocks; D41), a bright yellow two-tone multi-leaf door (D41), Ja'far Sweets' orange-red Z-braced two-leaf doors with a circle-pattern transom (D42), white panelled double doors in green frames for Al-Wad (D14). I used door_olive / rolldown_grey / door_teal / door_green2 for KeZ and blue/green cells for the Damascus Gate street (notes 1.5: blue, green, grey).

FACADE FEATURES for w1393172385 (Taha/Halawani building, edge at [300.24,504.08]): (a) a white-framed enclosed timber box window on corbels over the Halawani shop at the 1st floor, ~2.4 m wide x 1.8 m, projecting ~0.6 m, many small panes, with a narrow side window (D30) - approximated by a 2.4 m glass window; (b) a parapet screen of terracotta pipes laid in triangles (pigeon-hole pattern, ~2 m tall) on top of the street front (D30, also seen from the ramparts in D31).

KHAN EZ-ZEIT VAULTS: Khan ez-Zeit north (w256298879, y 430-484) has pointed barrel vaults (whitewashed rubble, springing ~3 m, crown ~4.5 m, aluminium AC ducts, a dark hanging lantern) over some bays, alternating with open bays under corrugated canopies; the first bay at the north entrance (y ~474-484) is vaulted (D41, taken 50 s after the fork photo D22). A profile can only cover whole ways and this one continues through s05, so it needs covered segments by s-range (e.g. vault s 12-22 and s 40-48 of w256298879).

OSM ROOFS OVER LANES (make_spec / build_city): building=roof + layer=1 features that span a highway are built as solid blocks and closed the streets: w1393280745 over Al-Wad (330-339, 470-478), w1394054817 over Ash Sheikh Rihan (431-441, 478-486), w1394054424 over Ibn Jarrah (397-407, 552-564), w1393163043 over al-Malawiya (486-498, 553-562). Build them as a roof or sabat over the passage (clear height ~4 m, room above or slab on piers). I removed them in the profile (remove_buildings) so the streets are walkable; drop those entries when the builder supports it. No photo shows any of the four (notes 1.9 review).

ASH SHEIKH RIHAN (w26492740) is tagged layer=-2 in OSM but is the open lane from the fork (311.7,496.3) east to x 633 (it is the only link from the fork to Rassas Ascent). Infill and stairs skip negative layers, so infill blocked it in ~150 m of s08 (f48, f57, f59, f60, f66) and probably beyond x 560 (s10). Please re-layer it to 0 in make_spec like the covered souqs; my s08 open-area strip (3.2 m) is a stopgap.

CLIP_STREETS: w1393172389 crosses the Al-Wad centreline (way 26496070) at (358-361, 438-442), leaving 2.1-2.5 m: add (26496070, 1.7). w1393163030 crosses Aqabat Er-Rahbat (way 1393163029) at s 9-10: add (1393163029, 1.2). Measured on the spec with build/spec_s08_damascus/tools/width.py.

INFILL CORRIDORS (infill.street_halfwidth): the half-width is the 25th percentile of the centreline's distance to the nearest building, and in the Old City the OSM centreline often hugs one wall, so the other side gets a 1.5-4 m infill strip in front of the real street wall. Baseline: Al-Wad north 3.4 m wide (OSM 4.7-7.6 m), Khan ez-Zeit north 3.0 m (OSM 4.1-4.3 m), the foot of the Damascus Gate street ~4 m (OSM 8.9 m, D28/D30), the west row of KeZ and the Taha/Halawani front hidden behind infill. Measure per side, or skip infill on a side where an OSM building lies within ~8 m. My open areas fix only s08's main streets.

HEIGHTS ON SLOPES (make_spec): top = highest ground under the ring + height, so a footprint on a slope gets a much taller downhill front: w291225673 stood 18.3 m above the Damascus Gate street (6 m of fall across it; photos D01/D29 show ~13 m). I compensated in the overrides (heights measured from the street frontage), but the rule affects every hillside block in s08 (Rassas Ascent climbs 16.5 m, Sheikh Lulu 13 m). Suggest the mean ground or the ground of the longest exposed street edge.

RENDER TOOL: blender/render_city.py zg() only ray-casts the base ground mesh, which has holes under the step runs, so a camera on any stepped street (the whole Damascus Gate street, its foot, Sheikh Lulu) silently gets z = 0 + height, ~20-25 m above the street. Flag step meshes as ground or fall back to terrain_street.street_z. I rendered with --abs and absolute z from the street model (build/spec_s08_damascus/tools/cams.py).

GATE LANDMARK (landmarks_gates, w616186088) seen from the inner square (renders d01/d24/d29 vs photos D01/D24/D29): the inner portal face (e15/e16) renders as a flat untextured surface; D24 shows coursed ashlar (~0.5 m courses), a double-moulded pointed arch with an opening ~3.5-4.5 m wide, three small rosettes above the apex and two plain discs, a parapet at ~8-10 m with a black steel railing and plants (notes 3.7). From the square the outer screen's stepped merlons with pointed finials should show above the portal parapet (D01, D29).
